channel.title: Violations Watch: Sudan
channel.description: New incidents reported in Sudan. Most entries are unverified leads, not findings.

item.title: Drone strike attributed to the Sudanese army hits a football field in Abu Qalb, Abu Zabad locality, West Kordofan: 13–15 civilians killed, including four children (Kordofan Human Rights Observatory)
item.description: Unverified lead (Critical priority). Abu Qalb, Abu Zabad, Sudan. Types: Killing of civilians, Air / drone / artillery strike. Alleged perpetrator: Sudanese Armed Forces (attributed). Reported casualties: 13-15 killed. Grave violations against children: Killing and maiming. Disputed or caveats: Attribution to SAF by a rights observatory; tolls differ (13 vs 15); includes X account, not verified. 7 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-0912

item.title: Indiscriminate gunfire, including anti-aircraft weapons, in El Obeid, North Kordofan: one killed and more than 45 injured
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). El Obeid, North Kordofan, Sudan. Types: Killing of civilians. Alleged perpetrator: Not stated. Reported casualties: 1 killed, 45+ injured. Disputed or caveats: Shooters not identified in the report. 1 source. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-0753

item.title: RSF reported to have killed 10 civilians in a West Kordofan town, according to a Sudanese relief group
item.description: Unverified lead (High priority). West Kordofan, Sudan. Types: Killing of civilians. Alleged perpetrator: Rapid Support Forces (RSF). Reported casualties: 10 killed. Disputed or caveats: Single relief-group source via Anadolu; town not named in summary. 1 source. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-0617

item.title: INGOs warn October was one of the deadliest months for civilians from drone strikes in Sudan, citing a strike on Um Darfa hospital
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Sudan. Types: Air / drone / artillery strike, Attacks on healthcare & aid. Alleged perpetrator: Parties to the conflict (SAF and RSF). Grave violations against children: Attacks on schools and hospitals. Disputed or caveats: Aggregate NGO statement; individual incidents not detailed in the summary. 1 source. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-0656

item.title: At least 17 civilians killed in Kordofan, 2–4 Nov; army bombing destroys a water station
item.description: Unverified lead (High priority). Kordofan, Sudan. Types: Killing of civilians, Air / drone / artillery strike, Destruction of property. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-0001
